scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @video-recap/api" "npm run dev -w @video-recap/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w video-util && npm run build -w @video-recap/api && npm run build -w @video-recap/web && npm run build -w @video-recap/youtube-recap-cli
scripts.check: npm run build -w video-util && npm run check -w video-util && npm run check -w @video-recap/api && npm run check -w @video-recap/web && npm run check -w @video-recap/youtube-recap-cli
scripts.preview:link: npm run build -w video-util && tsx scripts/preview-link.ts
scripts.test: npm run test -w video-util && npm run test -w @video-recap/api && npm run test -w @video-recap/youtube-recap-cli
